Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates extensive subcutaneous emphysema (surgical emphysema) visible as radiolucent streaks in the soft tissues of the neck, supraclavicular regions, and axillae. This widespread distribution along fascial planes correlates with the clinical presentation of neck swelling and chest pain radiating to the neck due to air tracking from the mediastinum or pleural space into the subcutaneous tissues.
